mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm_order WHERE kind = 'PURCHASE' AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL') AND delivery_date < #{today}) AS "purchaseOverdue", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm_order WHERE kind = 'SALES' AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL') AND delivery_date < #{today}) AS "salesOverdue", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm_shipment WHERE status = 'EXCEPTION') AS "shipmentException"
